readme.markdown:
# Tweetsmash MCP Server: X (Twitter) Bookmarks for AI Agents

The Tweetsmash MCP server connects Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Raycast, and any
Model Context Protocol client to your X (Twitter) bookmarks. Search them
semantically, count them, and manage labels through natural language.

[Tweetsmash](https://www.tweetsmash.com) is a bookmark manager for X (Twitter):
it imports the posts you bookmark on X into a searchable library, syncs them to
Notion, Google Sheets, and Zotero, and exposes them to AI agents through this
MCP server and an [X bookmarks API](https://www.tweetsmash.com/x-bookmarks-api).

## Quick start

1. Create a Tweetsmash account at [tweetsmash.com](https://www.tweetsmash.com) and
   import your X bookmarks (one click).
2. Generate an API token: Settings > Integrations > API.
3. Add the server to your MCP config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "tweetsmash": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["@tweetsmash/mcp"],
      "env": { "TWEETSMASH_TOKEN": "your-token-here" }
    }
  }
}
```

### Hosted endpoint (no local install)

Point any remote MCP client at:

```
https://mcp.tweetsmash.com/api/mcp
```

with your Tweetsmash API token as a Bearer header.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_bookmarks` | Page through saved posts with filters |
| `search_bookmarks` | Keyword and semantic search across every bookmark |
| `get_bookmark_count` | Count bookmarks, optionally by label |
| `list_labels` | List every label in your library |
| `add_labels_to_tweets` | Label bookmarks from your agent |
| `remove_labels_from_tweets` | Remove labels |
| `setup_vector_store` | Build the semantic search index |

## Example prompts

- "Find my bookmarks about prompt engineering"
- "How many bookmarks mention MCP?"
- "Label everything I saved last week as AI"

## Links

- [X Bookmarks MCP](https://www.tweetsmash.com/x-bookmarks-mcp)

toolsPreview.name: list_bookmarks
toolsPreview.description: List user's Twitter bookmarks with optional filtering and pagination. Supports filtering by read status, media type, author, tags, date ranges, and sorting options. IMPORTANT: Use this tool (with the 'author' parameter) when the user asks to show tweets by a specific author.

toolsPreview.name: search_bookmarks
toolsPreview.description: Search through a user's Twitter bookmarks using keyword search (q), semantic search (vector_search_term), or author filtering (author). At least one of q, vector_search_term, or author should be provided. IMPORTANT: Use the 'author' parameter for filtering by author, not the 'q' field.

toolsPreview.name: get_bookmark_count
toolsPreview.description: Get the total count of user's bookmarks with optional filtering. Useful for understanding the size of bookmark collections before listing them.

toolsPreview.name: list_labels
toolsPreview.description: List all user's labels with their usage counts. Useful for discovering existing labels before adding new ones.

toolsPreview.name: add_labels_to_tweets
toolsPreview.description: Add a label to a list of tweets. Can use an existing label by ID or create a new label by name. Either label_id or label_name must be provided.

toolsPreview.name: remove_labels_from_tweets
toolsPreview.description: Remove a label from a list of tweets using label_name.

toolsPreview.name: setup_vector_store
toolsPreview.description: Initialize the vector store for semantic bookmark search. CRITICAL: When vector/semantic search fails with 'Vector Store Not Setup' error, call this tool. This is an async operation that may take a few minutes for large bookmark collections.

toolsPreview.name: search_docs
toolsPreview.description: Answer questions about Tweetsmash itself — features, how-to, pricing, plans, limits, account/subscription. Searches the bundled product guide and returns the most relevant sections for you to answer from. Call with an empty query to list the help topics.

toolsPreview.name: get_bookmark
toolsPreview.description: Get a single saved bookmark with FULL content in one call — the full X Article body, the unrolled thread, notes, and (optionally) replies. Use `include` (comma list of article,thread,notes,replies) to narrow it; defaults to article,thread,notes. Use this when the user wants to read or summarize a specific saved tweet/thread/article in depth.

toolsPreview.name: tag_bookmarks_by_filter
toolsPreview.description: Add a label to EVERY bookmark matching a filter, in a single call. Prefer this over listing then looping when the user says 'tag all my … as …'. Resolves an author name to its id automatically. Reports matched/tagged/failed counts.

toolsPreview.name: archive_bookmarks
toolsPreview.description: Archive, unarchive, delete, undelete, or mark read/unread a list of bookmarks by id (max 500). This is a bulk write; for destructive actions (delete) confirm with the user first. Reports how many changed.

toolsPreview.name: archive_bookmarks_by_filter
toolsPreview.description: Apply archive/unarchive/delete/undelete to EVERY bookmark matching a filter, in one call. Destructive by nature — confirm with the user before delete. Reports counts.

toolsPreview.name: list_smart_views
toolsPreview.description: List the user's Smart Views (saved filtered views). Each has a slug you pass to the other smart-view tools.

toolsPreview.name: get_smart_view
toolsPreview.description: Get a single Smart View by slug (its filter, tabs/buckets, and sort).

toolsPreview.name: get_smart_view_bookmarks
toolsPreview.description: List the bookmarks inside a Smart View, optionally scoped to one tab/bucket. Use the returned ids with archive_bookmarks / tagging tools to act on the view.

toolsPreview.name: create_smart_view
toolsPreview.description: Create a Smart View from a filter so the user can reuse it. Provide a name and the base_query (filter).

toolsPreview.name: update_smart_view
toolsPreview.description: Update a Smart View (name, filter, tabs, sort) by slug.

toolsPreview.name: delete_smart_view
toolsPreview.description: Delete a Smart View by slug.

toolsPreview.name: create_share_link
toolsPreview.description: Create a public, read-only share link for a set of bookmarks (explicit ids or everything matching a filter). Returns a share_url valid for 7 days. Free plans share up to 10 bookmarks.

toolsPreview.name: revoke_share_link
toolsPreview.description: Revoke a previously created share link by its token.

toolsPreview.name: trigger_pdf_export
toolsPreview.description: Start a PDF export of the user's bookmarks (explicit ids, everything matching a filter, or the whole library). Returns a job id; tell the user the file will appear in the Export Center.

toolsPreview.name: trigger_csv_export
toolsPreview.description: Start a CSV export (explicit ids, a filter, or the whole library). Returns a job id; the file appears in the Export Center.

toolsPreview.name: trigger_json_export
toolsPreview.description: Start a JSON export (explicit ids, a filter, or the whole library). Returns a job id; the file appears in the Export Center.

toolsPreview.name: list_digest_preferences
toolsPreview.description: List the user's email-digest schedules (frequency, time, paused state) for bookmark and Smart View digests.

toolsPreview.name: update_digest_preference
toolsPreview.description: Update a digest schedule (enable/pause, frequency, time) by id.

toolsPreview.name: delete_digest_preference
toolsPreview.description: Remove a digest schedule by id.

toolsPreview.name: list_past_digests
toolsPreview.description: List past digests sent to the user's email, newest first.

toolsPreview.name: get_sync_status
toolsPreview.description: Show the user's app-sync integrations (Notion, Google Sheets, Zotero): whether each is connected/enabled, synced vs pending counts, and any errors.

toolsPreview.name: get_bookmark_sync_status
toolsPreview.description: Show whether a specific bookmark has synced to a given integration connection.

toolsPreview.name: list_twitter_lists
toolsPreview.description: List the X (Twitter) lists the user follows in Tweetsmash. Each has a connection id used by the other list tools.

toolsPreview.name: get_list_tweets
toolsPreview.description: Get recent tweets for a followed X list — the latest, or (sort=POPULARITY) the top/trending tweets in a look-back window. Use this to surface high-signal content the user can save. hours defaults to 24.

toolsPreview.name: get_list_digests
toolsPreview.description: List past Twitter-list email digests for the user.

toolsPreview.name: send_list_digest
toolsPreview.description: Build and email a digest of a Twitter list's high-signal tweets to the user now.

toolsPreview.name: get_me
toolsPreview.description: Get the current user's account: identity, current plan and status, and usage (e.g. AI chat credits). Use this to answer 'who am I' / 'what plan am I on'.

toolsPreview.name: get_connection_status
toolsPreview.description: Check whether the user's tweets can be pulled: the X (Twitter) API connection (connected / disconnected), whether the browser extension has synced recently, and a rolled-up can_pull + how (x_api or extension). Use this before a sync, or when the user asks why bookmarks aren't updating. Note: the extension is browser-only and can't be driven by an agent.

toolsPreview.name: fetch_recent_bookmarks
toolsPreview.description: Force-pull the user's most recent bookmarks from the X API now (server-side). Requires a connected X account; if the account only syncs via the browser extension, this reports that a browser sync is needed. Use when the user asks to refresh / fetch their latest saves. For Twitter-list freshness, use get_list_tweets instead.

toolsPreview.name: remember
toolsPreview.description: Store a durable memory about the user (a preference, style, fact, or instruction) so future sessions can use it. Never store secrets or credentials.

toolsPreview.name: recall
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve durable memories about the user, optionally filtered by a substring query.

toolsPreview.name: forget
toolsPreview.description: Delete a durable memory by key (and optional kind).
